stages.next_smallest_task: Define three permissible practice targets and compute their independently measured learning-value labels on development tasks.

stages.title: Run ten chronological T0/T1/T2/T3 learning cycles
stages.task: Start all arms from the selected frozen parent and same permitted archive. T0 persists nothing, T1 records only, T2 fixed-schedule verified replay/candidates, T3 learned practice plus candidates. Include distribution change, no-improvement period, restart, rejection and rollback.
artifacts: planned: chronological costs, exposure and publication history
stages.interface: Common experience stream -> arm-specific allowed persistent state -> matched later evaluation. T2 replay-matched shadow control isolates T3 data-selection effects.
stages.acceptance_gate: Report all ten cycles, old/new family scores, forward transfer, forgetting, calibration, inquiry cost and rejection. T3 beyond T1 supports learning; T3 beyond T2 at stated budgets supports useful selection. Final audit remains unseen until reporting.
stages.resources: Ten initial bounded cycles; extend to 30–50 only after useful error bars/instrumentation. Match evaluation compute and disclose extra learning compute.
stages.on_failure: Do not hide failed cycles or reset history after regression. Reject damaged candidates and preserve a valid negative/inconclusive longitudinal result.
stages.next_smallest_task: Freeze the chronological stream, retention matrix and per-cycle resource/exposure budget before cycle 1.

stages.title: Collect authentic source decision episodes
stages.task: Use the existing interview worksheet to collect real decisions, alternatives, information available then, constraints, reasons, sacrificed tradeoffs and decisive counterfactuals. Preserve original spans, uncertainty, dates and separate allowed uses; never fabricate missing personal history.
artifacts: planned: private authentic source archive and consent/lineage manifest
stages.interface: Human source statement/document -> confirmed source record -> topic/decision family -> permitted retrieval/training/evaluation use. Assistant inference remains a proposed inference.
stages.acceptance_gate: Each record traces to authentic source testimony with allowed use; source facts, later interpretation, hypothetical, synthetic persona and agent experience are distinct. Complete decision families are split before variants.
stages.resources: Human-source collection in short sessions; start 5–10 independent cases, grow toward proposed 30–100. Private source files stay local and out of default Git/public logs.
stages.on_failure: Leave unknown fields blank/unknown. Continue generic architecture work independently; no synthetic biography substitutes for source input.
stages.next_smallest_task: Prepare a local intake record for the first real decision and request/consume source material only when the human supplies it.

stages.title: Create dated identity snapshots and branch ownership
stages.task: Create an approved source snapshot and explicit source_snapshot/source_current/parallel_replica/assistant_for_source modes. Separate human updates from agent branch events and track correction/deletion lineage through examples, encodings and adapters.
stages.interface: Authentic archive -> reviewed dated snapshot -> identity-mode runtime binding. Human source authority updates source identity; agent events update only its branch.
stages.acceptance_gate: Historical answers use only information available then; source_current respects approved corrections; parallel branch experiences never become human autobiography. Deletion revokes retrieval and marks dependent trained artifacts for rebuild.
stages.resources: CPU ledger tests with fictional controls; authentic snapshots contain only allowed source material. Neural erasure is a separate unlearning/retraining question.
stages.on_failure: Quarantine disputed interpretations and preserve prior dated snapshots; never overwrite uncertain history to force consistency.
stages.next_smallest_task: Encode one authentic preference plus its exception and a later correction in a dated snapshot.

stages.title: Measure evidence-conditioned Replica baselines
stages.task: Before personal tuning, compare generic, approved-summary and archive-retrieval systems on sealed source decisions and unknown biography. Include decisive versus irrelevant counterfactual changes and repeated human choices to estimate reference variability.
artifacts: planned: held-out decision protocol and blinded review packet
stages.interface: Evaluator-owned decision cases + same available source information -> randomized blinded systems -> source review and objective factual checks.
stages.acceptance_gate: Choice/ranking, information requests, rationale fit, unknown handling, time and ownership scored separately. Report raw agreement and human test-retest variability; no percentage-of-person claim.
stages.resources: Small human review sessions; fixed inference budget and source exposure across systems. Hold out topic/decision families, not paraphrases.
stages.on_failure: Do not tune on reviewed final cases. If a source changes their view or both choices are plausible, preserve that outcome rather than forcing a label.
stages.next_smallest_task: Reserve complete decision families for evaluation before producing any teacher expansion.

stages.title: Test decision conditioning and internal memory separately from style
stages.task: Train a small source-grounded preference/reader candidate with general replay. Compare plain full tuning and augmented tuning on the same authentic decisions where appropriate. Keep optional voice/style adaptation separate from source facts and conditional priorities.
artifacts: planned: personal candidate manifest and mixture audit
stages.interface: Confirmed train-role decisions -> bounded derived targets -> candidate trainer -> independent fidelity and competence evaluator. Every derivative retains its original decision group.
stages.acceptance_gate: Useful held-out conditional decision fidelity beyond evidence-only baseline without material competence loss or invented autobiography. Style similarity alone does not pass; repeating a tiny archive does not create independent evidence.
stages.resources: Low initial personal mixture share or separable adapter; bounded epochs/rates selected on development. Exact training scope labelled full_text, modules_only or adapter.
stages.on_failure: If evidence-only baseline explains gains, retain it and report the personal neural update as unproven. Correct unsupported targets rather than training harder.
stages.next_smallest_task: Choose one confirmed conditional principle and test unseen related situations before expanding the personal mixture.

stages.title: Evaluate a developing parallel Replica over time
stages.task: Combine one authentic conditional priority with one independently verified technical skill, then follow source_current and parallel_replica branches through chronological learning. Trace every divergence to a source revision or agent event.
artifacts: planned: branch comparison and provenance history
stages.interface: Versioned identity snapshot + accepted skill manifest + branch event journal -> later tasks -> factual, decision and technical outcome evaluators.
stages.acceptance_gate: The system applies a learned procedure to new values/compositions, retains source attribution and handles real preference changes. General correctness and faithful prediction of a source belief remain separate dimensions.
stages.resources: Reuse the ten-cycle infrastructure; schedule source review only for meaningful new material. Extend horizon only after initial stable evidence.
stages.on_failure: Preserve and explain legitimate branch divergence; do not rewrite human source records to match agent development or force agreement.
stages.next_smallest_task: Create one unseen microengineering task where the approved conditional priority changes a valid planning choice.

stages.title: Pin and qualify the native small VLM
stages.task: Resolve/seal MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B model, processor and native code revisions. Inventory text/vision/projector groups; load actual image inputs and test native forward/generation plus hybrid recurrent/attention cache behavior before adding memory.
artifacts: planned: V4.7 source/processor lock and tensor inventory
stages.interface: Image asset manifest -> causal asset loader -> native processor expansion/mRoPE/visual insertion -> hybrid model; separate from LlamaMemoryAdapter Llama integration.
stages.acceptance_gate: Changing relevant pixels changes the expected answer, and cache/re-prefill results agree within tolerance. Processor-expanded lengths, image crops/tokens and recurrent/attention states are traced and restart-owned.
stages.resources: One small VLM resident; first CPU/tiny contract then bounded native Mac profile. Pin new environment separately if native requirements conflict with the text lock.
stages.on_failure: Stop at unsupported native kernels/caches and document exact limitation. Caption text alone never qualifies as multimodal execution.
stages.next_smallest_task: Pin the native V4.7 revision and inspect processor output shapes for one synthetic image/question pair.

stages.title: Implement distinct full_text and full_vlm training scopes
stages.task: Build a V4.7-specific adapter/collator preserving native hybrid states. Explicitly register decoder/embeddings/head, vision, projector and new modules. Test full_text with declared frozen vision separately from full_vlm with all original modal parameters eligible.
artifacts: planned: multimodal collator and parameter registry
planned: image-gradient/update and full_vlm restart audits
stages.interface: Causal text/image episode -> native collator/loss masks -> modal group optimizer -> native save/processor reload. No image-reference string stands in for a tensor.
stages.acceptance_gate: Actual vision/projector gradients and changed tensors in full_vlm; full_text reports frozen groups honestly. Response masks, native caches, source causality, export/reload and resume pass.
stages.resources: Microbatch 1, measured text/image budgets and checkpointing; reduce image count/resolution only as declared protocol variables.
stages.on_failure: Do not silently freeze modal groups to fit. Preserve a full_text result separately; add residency changes for any failed full_vlm claim.
stages.next_smallest_task: Trace an image-dependent loss backward to named vision and projector parameters on the smallest native batch.

stages.title: Evaluate multimodal memory and chronology controls
stages.task: Release a separate proposed 3,000-target tranche with eligible multimodal personas and solver-backed visual chronology. Compare native/evidence-only/augmented systems with true images, text-only, shuffled images and removed images.
artifacts: planned: modal episode and asset release manifest
planned: image-dependence, temporal and cost ablation report
stages.interface: Asset lineage + episode cutoff -> modal collator -> fixed multimodal evaluator; image/task families inherit source split.
stages.acceptance_gate: Useful gain depends on relevant pixels and chronological evidence, survives image/shuffle controls, and includes modal parameter/compute costs. No caption-only or future-frame leakage claim.
stages.resources: Separate text/image token budget from the 20k text pilot. Start a small solver-backed visual slice before optional public assets.
stages.on_failure: Fix asset availability/cutoff/processor bugs or record no visual benefit. Do not inflate text evidence by silently adding image-derived gold captions.
stages.next_smallest_task: Generate paired visual scenes differing in exactly one decisive attribute with independent expected answers.

stages.title: Test one optional memory mechanism at a time
stages.task: Choose one hypothesis from functional linear fast state, Titans-style update, uTTT shared ownership, Engram lookup, Hope multi-rate updates or frozen latent interface. Declare state owner, loss, reset, chunk barrier and matched private/capacity/compute controls.
artifacts: planned: single-mechanism preregistration and version-pinned source notes
planned: causal/state-isolation/backend and transfer ablation report
stages.interface: Observed chunk-start snapshot -> all depth reads -> combined post-chunk writes -> session/branch-owned state; published model parameters remain independently versioned.
stages.acceptance_gate: No future-token influence, cross-session contamination, storage writes during checkpoint recomputation or stale source encodings. Mechanism adds useful held-out benefit beyond the simplest control at stated memory/compute cost.
stages.resources: Begin linear-state CPU/tiny MPS tests; one optional mechanism per run. Do not import CUDA/Triton or higher-order requirements into the stable text env without qualification.
stages.on_failure: If no extra value, omit the mechanism. Do not activate all research papers simultaneously or block the learned loop awaiting a reproduction.
stages.next_smallest_task: Write a falsifiable one-mechanism hypothesis and an adversarial chunk-boundary causality case.

stages.title: Qualify Muon8bit on the actual Blackwell host
stages.task: Inventory actual RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF UUID/memory, host RAM, driver/CUDA/PyTorch build and native dtype support. Reproduce tiny CPU/CUDA optimizer routing, INT8 state, checkpoint and D0/D1/D2 updates before native training.
artifacts: planned: CUDA tiny optimizer, dtype and resume parity report
stages.interface: Same optimizer equations/named eligibility and source lock -> CUDA backend; any BF16 autocast or residency change is separately declared.
stages.acceptance_gate: No CPU fallback, all intended groups updated, state/resume correct and independent numerical tests pass. Inventory confirms actual available memory; vendor 24 GB is not a measured free-memory value.
stages.resources: Later target only; no installed CUDA device assumed on this Mac. Use a separate platform lock/environment and one bounded tiny job.
stages.on_failure: Resolve build/kernel incompatibility before full model. Keep Mac evidence valid and do not infer CUDA success from it.
stages.next_smallest_task: On arrival of the workstation, capture GPU UUID, nvidia-smi and PyTorch device/dtype probes.

stages.title: Implement a full-scope 24 GB residency solution
stages.task: Implement training-aware CPU optimizer offload or qualified ZeRO/FSDP partitioning for the mixed Muon/AdamW registry, or separately validate a lower-residency layout. The current FP32 full-text persistent 26.40 GB budget already exceeds card capacity before activations.
artifacts: planned: offload/partition placement and dtype manifest
planned: full D0/D2 CUDA memory/transfer/scope/resume report
stages.interface: Named full registry -> sharding/offload adapter -> native wrapper/optimizer -> checkpoint portability. Ordinary DDP and inference device_map do not pool training memory.
stages.acceptance_gate: All originals including embeddings/head stay trainable in D0/D2, actual changed-tensor audit passes, finite updates and resume meet tolerance, and measured peak/host staging/transfers fit the declared capacity.
stages.resources: 24 GB target GPU plus inventoried host RAM; measure pinned buffers/PCIe transfers and CPU copies. First 256 real tokens then 512. Muon partition semantics require explicit validation.
stages.on_failure: If full scope cannot fit, preserve the failure and redesign residency; label modules-only/LoRA alternatives honestly. Never freeze layers while calling it full fine-tuning.
stages.next_smallest_task: Build a per-group weight/gradient/state/temporary placement ledger and test offload on the tiny mixed optimizer.

stages.title: Port only earned mechanisms to larger frozen models
stages.task: Select one larger target from the declared Gemma/MiniCPM-V roster after reconfirming official architecture/license/revision. Build new readers/calibrators and native cache/processor adapters; re-encode approved source memories using the new producer.
artifacts: planned: native baseline and frozen-interface/candidate profile
stages.interface: Portable source records + protocol + verified skill semantics -> new model-specific encoders/interfaces; small-model latent tensors are not transferred as aligned memories.
stages.acceptance_gate: Native baseline and null parity, exact frozen-base hashes, compatible candidate publication, measured fit/latency and held-out gains beyond evidence-only controls. Larger native capability may require harder fresh tasks.
stages.resources: Profile storage for all MoE parameters, not active-per-token count. Default larger base frozen; qualify actual inference/extension-training residency before campaign.
stages.on_failure: Stop a model port if memory or interface quality fails; do not silently change target spelling, use active parameter count as storage, or claim transfer from source-record reuse alone.
stages.next_smallest_task: Choose one earned small-model mechanism and define the corresponding larger-model native insertion/ownership contract.

stages.title: Run longer operation with migration and audit
stages.task: Extend chronological operation with versioned source/branch histories, held-out skill transfer, drift, source correction/deletion, rollback and model migration. Replenish promotion windows independently and reserve fresh audit families for final reporting.
artifacts: planned: long-horizon retention/fidelity and cost matrix
planned: model/source migration, rollback and rebuild playbook
stages.interface: Accepted manifests + source lineage + branch journals -> reproducible deployments -> independent chronological evaluator and human-source fidelity review.
stages.acceptance_gate: Useful later behavior and retained critical tasks at declared costs, traceable branch divergence, successful rollback/rebuild and no hidden audit reuse. Report negative/inconclusive periods and changing source preferences.
stages.resources: Extend horizon from ten cycles only after reliable instrumentation; determine cap from measured wall time and evaluator independence, not arbitrary perpetual running.
stages.on_failure: Pause publication on hard invariant failure while retaining the last accepted manifest. Restore independent evaluation before restarting candidate acceptance.
stages.next_smallest_task: Review ten-cycle failure modes and define which longer-horizon uncertainty the next bounded campaign will resolve.
